business_research.analyst_coverage: One identifiable research provider, not a consensus dataset. No verified like-for-like 2030/2035 revenue, margin and FCFF analyst consensus was obtained.
business_research.management_coverage: Verified release guidance covers the next quarter. Longer-term AI ambitions discussed by analysts are labeled secondary reports; no verified management 2030/2035 operating forecast is claimed.
business_research.competition: Custom silicon competes with general-purpose GPU ecosystems, rival ASIC design partners and customers internalizing more design work. Power, advanced packaging, customer financing and AI monetization constrain delivery. Market size does not establish achievable share or profit.
business_research.capital_allocation_conclusion: Mixed evidence: dividends and repurchases fit within annual FCF, but diluted shares still increased. VMware added a profitable software platform, while the cash-and-stock cost and debt exposure make standalone acquisition returns essential. Consolidated returns do not establish a deal IRR.
